text:
Which statements about dilute ethanoic acid are correct?
1
It has a pH of 8.
2
It is an organic compound.
3
It turns universal indicator orange-yellow.
4
It reacts with magnesium to produce carbon dioxide.
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
subject: Chemistry
